name: fiber-scope-aware-route-conflict-policies
instr:
Fiber cannot detect, report, or reject semantically ambiguous route declarations before they affect routing. Implement immutable Router policy derivations that apply at effective request locations across groups, domains, chains, and mounts. Without a policy, and for admitted declarations, existing routing behavior remains unchanged.

Allow admits silently. Report admits and invokes its reporter. Reject panics with RouteConflictError before observable mutation. Determine conflicts from normalized methods, paths, constraints, middleware prefixes, and host scope; provably disjoint constraints or hosts remain independent. Records identify both declarations, affected methods, scopes, kind, and admission outcome without depending on pointer identity. Deliver each once per candidate-existing pair in method and declaration order. Reporter panics do not change admission. Rejection is atomic across stacks, counters, hooks, naming, automatic HEAD routes, indexes, rebuilds, and requests.

Policies and effective scope survive every Router derivation; the originating Router remains independent. Admitted declarations preserve automatic and explicit HEAD semantics, ordering, mounts, domain fallback, Endpoint and Route observations, and Fiber, Express-style, net/http, and fasthttp handler propagation. The github.com/gofiber/fiber/v3 API includes Router.WithRoutePolicy, App.WithRoutePolicy, and Group.WithRoutePolicy; `(Router) WithRoutePolicy(policy RoutePolicy) Router`, `(app *App) WithRouteP
